name: Convivial Profiler
description: Client-side visitor personalization and data-collection engine: an admin-configured source/processor/destination pipeline run by an external JS SDK that stores a behavioural profile in the browser (cookies/localStorage) and pushes events to the dataLayer.
library_dependencies: morpht/convivial-profiler (external JS bundle loaded from cdn.jsdelivr.net at runtime)
project_description:
Provides ability for personalization and visitor data collection.

 Requirements 
 
 Convivial Core 
 
 Installation 
 The module can be installed via the standard Drupal installation process. 

 Configuration 
 Go to /admin/config/convivial/profiler and set all the configuration options.

 Maintainers
